building_identity.chapter: Delta Sigma Phi, Delta Delta Chapter, Purdue University
building_identity.identity_decision: Confirmed: Purdue ArcGIS FID 798 attributes explicitly name Delta Sigma Phi and 341 Northwestern Av; chapter-linked address listing and West Lafayette municipal planning source independently identify 341 Northwestern as the Delta Sigma Phi house. The 860826641 candidate footprint is the corresponding source geometry; adjacent candidate 860826640 is a neighboring building and not FID 798.

geometry.geometry_source: Purdue GIS FID 798 outer polygon; source bounds correspond to the 860826641 building candidate, while the 860826640 candidate is adjacent and outside this FID geometry.
geometry.source_crs: EPSG:4326 response; converted with project approximate local formula, origin (lat 40.4274, lon -86.9137), x=(lon+86.9137)*84810.60416539927 m, y=(lat-40.4274)*111040 m; X east, Y north, Z up.
geometry.local_frame: Geometry is centered at polygon centroid (357.7400581597, -73.8297415800) m in campus-local XY and rotated so local u follows official minimum-rotated-rectangle long axis 129.444055 degrees east-CCW; local v is perpendicular. Detailed asset geometry is local; parent manifest/master placement must use this centroid.

source_attributes_conflict.decision: ArcGIS Shape__Area and Shape__Length attributes disagree with the retrieved WGS84 polygon after the documented approximate project transform (computed 498.110 m2 and 119.335 m; attributes 861.027 m2 and 156.904 m). The geometry ring was used for walls; attributes were not used for geometry or height.

legacy_asset_footprint_comparison.method: Shapely polygon comparison of original massing object's six base vertices against FID 798 outer ring, both in documented campus-local approximation
legacy_asset_footprint_comparison.interpretation: Original block is a close but simplified footprint; updated wall perimeter uses the source ring itself. Added facade/roof/site details are excluded from wall-footprint matching.

geometry.height: Wall height 7.55 m and roof ridge 11.95 m are visual estimates from Street View/story rhythm, not surveyed values. Approximate uncertainty ±2 m. GIS Extrution=12 and NUM_LEVELS=1 are inconsistent with the visible multi-level facade and were not used as measured height.

geometry_edits: Replaced one 13-vertex, single-material massing block with exact FID 798 polygon wall shell and dedicated plinth surfaces.
Added procedural textured buff/red brick and dark slate/shingle materials; no external image dependencies.
Added two-story exterior window pattern, three arched lower windows, door/limestone surround, belt course, entrance steps, projecting gable and four front dormers based on current facade imagery.
Added a perpendicular roofed wing over the rear L-shaped footprint area.
No interior was modeled because no reliable plan evidence was located; no interior claims are made.

asset.coordinate_status: local coordinates; proposed master placement centroid is (357.7400581597, -73.8297415800) m. Shared manifest remains coordinator-owned and still needs a detailed-instance conversion before master integration.
